name: Murata Himeko
source: Leading the Hyperion to stop the Houkai, she met our heroine and offer help to get them out but being decline by Kiana Kaslana and then start fighting. Later the Hyperion being invaded by the zombies and ME mechas. With our heroine, she manages to take control of the Hyperion back (she got defeated by Kiana and her gang later) and transport our heroine back to meet Theresa Apokalypse with info about Kiana's father.
